objective: Test whether an online nearest-analog memory of joint SPY/UPRO/SPXU morning states can select the better executable afternoon ETF without future leakage, fixed regime thresholds, or latency dependence.
evidence_warning: The feature family was designed after extensive exposure to 2021-2026 research. This is a leak-free walk-forward algorithmic test, but not a pristine independent discovery. A passing result would still require future paper validation.

data.excluded: Dates officially marked degraded by Databento

features: SPY log return from 09:30 open to 10:59 close
SPY path efficiency: net log return divided by sum of absolute one-minute log returns
SPY log high-low range over the window
SPY realized variance: sum of squared one-minute log returns
SPY log return from 10:30 open to 10:59 close
UPRO residual minus SPXU residual after subtracting their theoretical plus/minus three-times SPY move
UPRO plus SPXU morning midpoint log returns
Median UPRO quote imbalance minus median SPXU quote imbalance
UPRO late-volume share minus SPXU late-volume share, where late means 10:15-10:59
morning_state.missing_data: Require complete SPY bars and complete valid pair BBO states. ETF trade-bar absences contribute zero volume but no price is filled.

potential_outcomes.upro: Long $100 fractional UPRO at the 11:01 ask, exit at 15:30 bid or after a completed SPY bar crosses 3.333333% below the 11:01 SPY open.
potential_outcomes.spxu: Long $100 fractional SPXU at the 11:01 ask, exit at 15:30 bid or after a completed SPY bar crosses 3.333333% above the 11:01 SPY open.
potential_outcomes.memory_update: Both potential outcomes become available to the algorithm only after that session has ended.

online_algorithm.standardization: For each current day, subtract the median and divide by interquartile range calculated only from prior valid sessions. Use scale one when prior IQR is zero.
online_algorithm.distance: Euclidean distance across the 12 robust-standardized features divided by square root of 12.
online_algorithm.neighbor_count: Ceiling of the square root of the number of prior valid sessions.
online_algorithm.neighbor_weighting: Uniform; no outcome or distance weighting.
online_algorithm.upro_forecast: Mean historical executable UPRO return among nearest neighbors.
online_algorithm.spxu_forecast: Mean historical executable SPXU return among nearest neighbors.
online_algorithm.choice: Choose the ETF with the higher forecast.
online_algorithm.trade_gate: The chosen mean forecast must be strictly positive and more than half of its neighbor outcomes must be strictly positive.
online_algorithm.ties: Skip exact forecast or vote ties.
online_algorithm.update_order: Make the current decision first, then add the current morning and both realized outcomes to memory after the close.

live_execution_model.latency: Ninety-minute state; stress with five additional entry minutes

prohibited_repairs: Change features, minimum memory, neighbor count, majority rule, distance, entry, exit, or stop after results.
Select only one instrument, year, month, volatility state, or score magnitude.
Tune k, a confidence threshold, or a cost buffer on observed P&L.
Use current or future outcomes in standardization or neighbor selection.
Present a passing backtest as independent validation.
